layout.relay_api: "pp-browser:relay-api" 00 u8(4) LenUtf8(audience) u8(op) i64(timestamp) ...the op's fields... u64(len(entries)) entries
layout.signed_bytes: header || the domain's fields (`domains`) || u64(len(entries)) entries
layout.encodings: LenUtf8 / LenBytes: u64 BE byte length, then the bytes; u64, i64 big endian; typed: LenBytes(u8 algorithm id || the algorithm's bytes)
layout.body: the fields, sign_version (4), audience (the relay's transport PeerId), timestamp, ext_b64 (standard base64 of the entries; left out when empty), signature (typed); no signature_alg

domains.fields: LenUtf8(challenge) LenBytes(public_key, typed) LenBytes(kem_public_key_b64, typed) i64(timestamp)
u8(op) i64(timestamp) LenUtf8(sender_account_id) LenUtf8(recipient_account_id) LenUtf8(stream_id) u64(index_key)
u8(op) i64(timestamp) LenUtf8(requester_account_id) LenUtf8(sender_account_id) LenUtf8(stream_id) u8(flags: 1 min, 2 max) [u64(min_index_key)] [u64(max_index_key)] u64(limit) u8(order: 0 asc, 1 desc)
u8(op) i64(timestamp) LenUtf8(account_id) LenUtf8(platform) LenUtf8(device_id) LenUtf8(push_token)
u8(op) i64(timestamp) LenUtf8(account_id) LenUtf8(platform) LenUtf8(device_id) LenUtf8(binding_id)

answers.client_upgrade_required: 426 code client_upgrade_required: sign_version none or older
answers.relay_upgrade_required: 400 code relay_upgrade_required: a newer sign_version, an unknown algorithm id, an unknown critical entry (after the signature)
answers.wrong_audience: 401 code wrong_audience: audience absent or not this relay's PeerId
answers.bad_signature: 401: the signature does not verify over the rebuilt bytes
answers.malformed: 400, any code but the upgrade ones: a field, the area or a typed blob malformed

calls.name: register.finish.sign_version_3
calls.why: read first, from the body alone: an older app (426), nothing else read

calls.name: register.finish.no_sign_version
calls.why: none named: an older app (426); there is no legacy window

calls.name: register.finish.sign_version_5
calls.why: a newer app: 400 relay_upgrade_required, before the audience; never a bad signature

calls.name: register.finish.no_audience
calls.why: the audience is checked after the version, before anything is spent

calls.name: register.finish.audience_swapped
calls.why: signed for a, sent naming b: b rebuilds the bytes with its own PeerId

calls.name: register.finish.unknown_signature_algorithm
calls.why: the signature's algorithm id 2: unknown, update needed (after the audience), not verified

calls.name: register.finish.malformed_signature
calls.why: algorithm id 0: refused as malformed, not verified

calls.name: register.finish.unknown_critical_entry
calls.why: it verifies, then the critical entry it does not know: update needed, not acted on

calls.name: register.finish.unsigned_critical_entry_added
calls.why: the area is in the signed bytes: an entry added after signing fails the signature, never says update

calls.name: register.finish.unsigned_entry_added
calls.why: the same for a non-critical entry

calls.name: register.finish.malformed_area
calls.why: ext_b64 of three bytes: no entry (SIGNED_EXTENSIONS § The extension area)

calls.name: register.finish.field_edited
calls.why: the signature covers every field

calls.name: register.finish.unknown_body_key
calls.why: unknown body keys are ignored

calls.name: register.finish.unknown_key_algorithm
calls.why: the signing key's algorithm id 2: update needed, not verified

calls.name: register.finish.unknown_kem_algorithm
calls.why: the KEM key's algorithm id 2: update needed, not verified
